Title: Build on SELISE Blocks
Choice: SELISE Blocks (IAM, Data Gateway, Storage, Mail) with a React web app
Rationale: Sign-in, data, files and email come ready on the platform, so the team builds only the ordering features.

Title: ERP export
Choice: A CSV export every evening at 18:30 into the existing ERP import
Rationale: It matches today's import and needs no change in the ERP.
Alternatives: Manual download by the order desk

Title: Fast on a phone
Choice: Usable within 2 seconds on a 4G phone and from 360 px wide
Rationale: Most orders are placed on a phone in the evening, so speed on mobile decides adoption.

Title: Customer price lists stay private
Choice: Each customer account sees only its own articles and prices (row-level access)
Rationale: Every customer has a personal price list and only sees the items delivered to them.

Title: Data volume
Choice: About 180 customers, 2,400 articles and 350 orders a week
Rationale: These are the figures Alpine Fresh gave in the email thread; the data model is sized for them.
